Meditation techniques and spiritual practices are like cards in a deck, representing qualities of the divine, through which such qualities may be realised or amplified. Each card is a means to reveal one or some facet of divine essence, or divine power. But true meditation, that which is beyond technique, means and willing, is the pocketing of the whole deck. It is the very being of divinity as a whole, the totality of facets, the diamond itself. It is, crucially, what allows for all practices, the very essence of practice, divinity's sum. No hand need be held, no games played, though one, in possession of the whole gamut of qualities, can hold any hand, and play any game as one so pleases.
